gate: Phase 4: RNW-6 (npx expo export --platform ios --platform android) passes on every eval output, and the manual Expo Go check passes
result: partial: RNW-6 runs and passes on Linux for the fixtures and for an export downloaded through the app, but not yet on live-model eval outputs; the Expo Go check has not run

environment.workspace: npm install of the export's package.json: 503 packages, 402 MB, 34 s

rnw6_fixtures.result: 12 of 14 bundle; the 2 failures are the ones the check exists to catch
rnw6_fixtures.cold_run: fixtures/App.jsx: iOS 2,573 modules in 42 s, Android 2,571 modules in 61 s (as on macOS in Phase 0), Hermes bytecode 3.7 MB each
rnw6_fixtures.warm_run_seconds: about 10 per screen once Metro's cache is warm; about 40 when App.jsx pulls in new modules (lucide)

outputs.broken-import.jsx: FAIL: Unable to resolve module @expo/vector-icons (not in the export's dependencies)
outputs.broken-icon.jsx: pass (an unknown lucide icon is undefined at runtime, not a bundling error)
outputs.lint-dom.jsx: pass (<div> and onClick crash only at runtime on a device)

rnw6_fixtures.conclusion: RNW-6 catches imports that don't resolve natively and syntax Metro rejects. Runtime failures (unknown icons, DOM elements, throws, hangs) need the preview's runtime_errors and the native-compat lint; bundling doesn't see them.

rnw6_through_the_app.result: pass: the Expo zip downloaded from the export menu after a scripted generation (App.jsx with its /local-assets avatar embedded in assets.js) bundles for iOS and Android

rnw6_live_eval_outputs.reason: the sandbox's network policy blocks api.openai.com (a 3-screen live eval run failed with connection errors before any spend) and no Anthropic or Gemini app key is set; the Phase 2 outputs are on the developer's machine, not in the repo
rnw6_live_eval_outputs.how_to_run: cd backend && poetry run python -m react_native.bundle_check evals_data/results/<run>/*.jsx, or rerun the evals with RN_BUNDLE_CHECK=1

expo_go.reason: no iOS Simulator (Linux), no Android emulator (no KVM, Android SDK downloads blocked)
expo_go.how_to_run: scripts/expo-go-check.sh <export.zip> ios|android on a machine with a booted simulator or emulator (untested), or open the export with Expo Go on a phone
